name: scanline-crt
prompt: CRT test pattern: color bars with scanlines and a subtle vignette; declare mediump precision for the helper functions.

provenance.via: claude --print with the in-app agent instructions (no Powermove MCP tools)

summary: The CRT test pattern shader layer is ready, but I haven't compiled or rendered it because no Powermove tools were attached to this run. It shows SMPTE-style 75% color bars, a middle strip and a bottom row with calibration patches, plus scanlines, a faint rolling bright band, a slight flicker and a subtle vignette. The helper functions are declared at mediump precision and main() switches back to highp; the bars put y=0 at the bottom of the layer, so they'll be upside down if v_uv works the other way. Controls you can adjust: uBrightness, uScanline, uScanPixels, uVignette, uFlicker, uRoll and uRollSpeed.
